description: Describes the steps to be taken across one or more APIs to achieve an objective

workflowId.description: Unique string to represent the workflow

summary.description: A summary of the purpose or objective of the workflow

description.description: A description of the workflow. CommonMark syntax MAY be used for rich text representation

inputs.description: A JSON Schema 2020-12 object representing the input parameters used by this workflow

dependsOn.description: A list of workflows that MUST be completed before this workflow can be processed

steps.description: An ordered list of steps where each step represents a call to an API operation or to another workflow

successActions.description: A list of success actions that are applicable for all steps described under this workflow

failureActions.description: A list of failure actions that are applicable for all steps described under this workflow

outputs.description: A map between a friendly name and a dynamic output value defined using a Runtime Expression or Selector Object. Keys must match the regex: ^[a-zA-Z0-9\.\-_]+$

parameters.description: A list of parameters that are applicable for all steps described under this workflow
